sentences.en: I hope you have brains enough to see the difference.
sentences.zh: 我希望你有足够的智慧看出其中的区别。

sentences.en: There is a fundamental difference between your opinion and mine.
sentences.zh: 你的观点和我的有根本性的区别。

sentences.en: It makes little difference whether you go today or tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 今天去和明天去差别不大。
